sources.name: Universal Base Characters
sources.author: Quaternius
sources.intended_use: humanoid topology, shared rig, male/female proportions, hairstyles
sources.notes: Free Standard package contains one male and one female underwear base on the same 65-joint humanoid rig, plus a partial hairstyle set. Female base is 15,060 triangles; male base is 14,318. The other body builds and the full 20-hairstyle set are not present in the free package and must not be claimed as acquired.

sources.name: Universal Animation Library
sources.author: Quaternius
sources.intended_use: humanoid locomotion, combat, interaction and death animation candidates
sources.notes: Free Standard GLB contains 43 clips at 30 fps. Its 65 joint names and order exactly match the audited base character. The technical preview uses 15 clips covering idle, walk, run, crouch, pistol, melee, hit, death, interaction and pickup. The advertised 120+ total belongs to the wider library; rifle and several directional variants remain missing from the free Standard package.

sources.name: Universal Animation Library 2
sources.author: Quaternius
sources.intended_use: melee, armed actions, work actions and zombie locomotion candidates
sources.notes: Free Standard GLB contains 43 clips on the same exact 65-joint rig. Seven clips are added to the technical preview for item use, throwing, harvesting, planting, watering, chopping and heavy hit. Zombie clips are reserved as candidates for infected humanoids. The free Standard package contains no rifle clips.

sources.name: Zombie Apocalypse Kit
sources.author: Quaternius
sources.intended_use: topology references and donor assets for survivors, infected, dogs, vehicles and props
sources.distribution: public Google Drive glTF subset: 64 self-contained files
sources.license_evidence_note: The bundled file states CC0 1.0 but contains a copied Ultimate Platformer Pack title. Keep the official Zombie Apocalypse Kit page as additional provenance evidence.
sources.notes: Audited contents: 14 animated character/enemy exports, 34 environment props, 6 vehicles and 10 weapons. Survivor geometry uses an incompatible 43-joint rig and baked clothing. Dogs, infected, weapons and props are reference/rebuild donors only. Do not import as-is; proportions, palette, PBR materials and wear must be rebuilt for Realm of Ashes.

sources.name: Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy
sources.author: Quaternius
sources.intended_use: reference implementation for modular skinned clothing on Universal Base Characters
sources.notes: Free Standard package contains 4 complete outfits and 20 modular parts. All 24 glTF files use the exact base 65-joint rig and have complete dependencies. Eight modules exceed the 4k target and require retopology. Several parts contain exposed skin, and the supplied workflow replaces the full body with only the base head, so direct use would break the Realm skin-tone and body-mask system. Use topology and rig construction as reference only; rebuild and restyle every accepted item.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.author: Poly Haven contributors
sources.intended_use: PBR terrain, concrete, rock, wood and metal source materials
sources.notes: Eight exact 1k Base Color, OpenGL Normal and ARM source sets cover all required surface families. Each asset ID, author, URL, API files_hash, file MD5 and local SHA-256 is pinned. Sources remain external-cache donors; stylized runtime derivatives require art approval and a generated recipe.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.author: ambientCG contributors
sources.intended_use: PBR fabric, leather, dirt, asphalt, concrete and corroded metal sources
sources.notes: Eight exact 1K-JPG archives are pinned through the official API v3 for fabric, leather, dirt, sand, cracked asphalt, damaged concrete, oxidized metal and weathered wood donor roles. ZIP inventories, paths, sizes and local SHA-256 are audited. Sources remain external-cache donors; stylized runtime derivatives require art approval and a generated recipe.

sources.name: Kenney City Kit (Industrial)
sources.author: Kenney
sources.intended_use: environment blockout and modular industrial silhouette donor
sources.notes: Version 1.0 contains 25 lightweight GLB files and one shared 512 px Base Color colormap. Buildings are monolithic, underscaled and too clean for direct use; no Normal/ORM, damage modules, LOD or colliders are supplied. Use only for blockout and rebuild in the approved Realm style.

sources.name: Kenney City Kit (Suburban)
sources.author: Kenney
sources.notes: Version 2.0 contains 40 lightweight GLB files and one shared 512 px Base Color colormap. Houses are clean monolithic miniatures without Normal/ORM, ruin modules, LOD or colliders. Rebuild accepted silhouettes and preserve authored world location IDs when replacing existing modules.

sources.name: Kenney Survival Kit
sources.author: Kenney
sources.intended_use: blockout and topology donors for tools, containers, workbenches, settlement modules, rocks and vegetation
sources.notes: Version 2.0 contains 80 lightweight GLB files and one shared 512 px Base Color colormap. Chest has open/close clips. Tools, containers, structures and nature are underscaled, clean and caricatured, with no Normal/ORM, LOD or colliders. Use only as blockout/rebuild donors after separate scale normalization by asset family.

sources.name: Kenney Blaster Kit
sources.author: Kenney
sources.intended_use: silhouette and topology donors for energy weapons, energy cells, optics and animated containers
sources.notes: Version 2.1 contains 18 toy-like blasters and 22 accessories, containers and target props. All use one shared Base Color colormap with no Normal/ORM or emissive mask. Crates have open/close clips. Use weapon geometry only as a rebuild reference; add functional energy components, sockets, consistent -Z orientation, PBR wear and LOD.

sources.name: Sci-Fi Modular Gun Pack
sources.author: Quaternius
sources.intended_use: modular geometry and silhouette donors for energy weapons, weapon parts, magazines and optics
sources.distribution: public Google Drive glTF subset: 70 exports
sources.notes: The official page advertises 78 models, while the audited free public glTF subset contains 20 assembled guns and 50 modular exports, including one duplicate GLB/glTF barrel pair. Do not claim all 78 models were acquired. The faceted geometry is a useful option-B donor, but every accepted weapon needs normalized scale and orientation, sockets, functional components, option-C PBR materials and wear, LOD and colliders.

sources.name: Ultimate Animated Animal Pack
sources.author: Quaternius
sources.intended_use: anatomy, rig and animation donors for brahmin and ash wolf rebuilds
sources.distribution: public Google Drive glTF subset: 12 self-contained files
sources.notes: All 12 public animal glTF files were audited: 26,740 triangles, 38-51 joints and 152 clips. Contrary to the page wording, Fox, Husky, ShibaInu and Wolf expose exactly 12 clips, not more than 12. Cow/Bull and Wolf/Husky are rebuild donors only; final creatures require new mutation silhouettes, materials, normalized scale, LOD, colliders, sockets and runtime animation contracts.

sources.name: Fantasy Props MegaKit Standard
sources.author: Quaternius
sources.intended_use: geometry and shared PBR trim donors for furniture, containers, workbenches, tools, provisions, chemical vessels and small inventory props
sources.distribution: free itch.io Standard archive: 94 glTF assets
sources.notes: The audited free Standard archive contains 94 of the 211 models advertised for the complete pack, 121,603 triangles and 13 shared PBR maps. Furniture, containers, tools and small props are useful donors, but bright fantasy silhouettes and materials require post-apocalyptic rebuilding, C-style wear, reduced runtime textures, LOD, sockets and generated colliders.

sources.name: Sci-Fi Essentials Kit Standard
sources.author: Quaternius
sources.intended_use: geometry, PBR and animation donors for medical consumables, ammunition, firearms, electronics, containers, technical furniture and future robots
sources.distribution: free itch.io Standard archive: 37 glTF assets
sources.notes: The audited free Standard archive contains 37 of the 65 advertised assets, 114,431 triangles, four animated assets and 32 shared maps. Health pack, syringe, ammo, weapons, lockers, crates and satellite dish are useful donors. Clean sci-fi materials, 4K crate maps and KHR_materials_specular/ior require a B+C rebuild, texture reduction and metallic/roughness bake for Three.js r125.
